endpoints.description: Registers a new user with the specified username and password, then automatically authenticates them and returns a JWT token.
Authenticates a user with username and password, returning a JWT token on success.
Retrieves the current authenticated user's ID, username, and authentication status from their token claims.
Changes the password for the current authenticated user.
Resets a specified user's password. Accessible only by administrators.
Exports a specific MongoDB collection as a compressed gzip archive backup file.
Exports all MongoDB collections as a consolidated backup zip archive. Accessible only by administrators.
Restores a specific MongoDB collection from an uploaded gzip archive backup file.
Retrieves keys currently tracked in memory cache grouped by prefix, along with the total count. Accessible only by administrators.
Clears all cached data items and clears the tracked key index from memory. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves all active campaigns registered in the system.
Retrieves complete details of a specific campaign by its unique ID.
Retrieves basic metadata of a specific campaign by ID, excluding loaded complex nested relationships.
Retrieves an overview of the campaign currently associated with the specified character ID.
Creates a new campaign and sets the current authenticated user as an owner.
Updates details of an existing campaign by ID.
Deletes a campaign by its unique ID if the authenticated user is an owner.
Retrieves all player characters currently enrolled in the specified campaign.
Enrolls a player character into the specified campaign.
Removes a player character from the specified campaign.
Associates a game world or map ID with the specified campaign.
Removes the association of a game world or map ID from the campaign.
Adds or associates a quest to the campaign.
Removes a quest from the specified campaign.
Links a journal note to the specified campaign.
Unlinks a journal note from the campaign.
Adds a session record to the specified campaign.
Removes a session record from the campaign.
Updates the active current session pointer for the campaign.
Sets the active encounter for the campaign to enable real-time tracking.
Clears the active encounter pointer for the specified campaign.
Retrieves all player characters stored in the system.
Retrieves the detailed character data for a specified ID.
Creates a new character, broadcasts the change to associated campaign players/DMs over SignalR, and returns the created character details.
Updates an existing character's stats and attributes and broadcasts the sync event via SignalR.
Deletes a character, triggers sync deletion updates to relevant users via SignalR, and returns NoContent.
Retrieves all characters owned by the currently authenticated user.
Uses one spell slot of the specified level for the character, updating their slot counts and broadcasting the change.
Recovers a specified amount of spell slots of a given level for the character and broadcasts the update.
Triggers a long rest action for a character, restoring hit points and spell slots, then broadcasts the sync update.
Initiates a long rest for multiple characters simultaneously and broadcasts updates for each successful character.
Retrieves the currencies associated with a specific character ID.
Deducts specific currencies from a character wallet and notifies relevant clients.
Transfers specific currencies to a target character and triggers sync notifications.
Adds currencies directly to a shared inventory (loot). Accessible only by administrators.
Transfers specified currencies directly from one character to another character. Accessible by Admins and Users.
Transfers specific currencies from a party inventory to a character's wallet. Accessible by Admins and Users.
Lists names of all collections active in the MongoDB database. Accessible only by administrators.
Simulates rolling a specified quantity of multi-sided dice publicly, enforces rate-limiting, and records the result in roll history.
Simulates a dice roll using standard formula notation passed as a query string parameter, enforces rate-limiting, and logs history.
Retrieves a specific combat encounter by its ID.
Retrieves a list of all combat encounters.
Retrieves all combat encounters associated with a specific campaign.
Retrieves all combat encounters tied to a specific session.
Creates a new combat encounter record and dispatches standard update notifications to clients.
Updates details of an existing combat encounter and broadcasts changes to active clients.
Deletes a combat encounter by ID and broadcasts deletion sync updates.
Creates a virtual encounter room for tabletop grid maps. The caller is assigned as the Dungeon Master.
Retrieves details and state of an encounter room (requires room membership/DM status).
Retrieves all virtual encounter rooms the current user is associated with as either player or DM.
Enables a player to join an active room by providing a temporary invite join code.
Allows a player to leave a room. DMs are prohibited from leaving and must end the room.
Soft-deletes/ends an active virtual encounter room. Accessible only by Dungeon Masters.
Generates a new entry join code for the virtual room. Accessible only by Dungeon Masters.
Sends invitations to listed user IDs for joining the room. Accessible only by Dungeon Masters.
Retrieves all equipment items in the global catalog.
Retrieves detailed properties of an equipment item by its database ID.
Retrieves public details of multiple equipment items by their IDs, optimized for inventory presentation.
Retrieves a specific equipment item by its unique index string (overrides base route).
Retrieves raw details of multiple equipment items by list of IDs.
Retrieves a paginated list of equipment items filtered optionally by tag, tier, damage type, or name.
Searches equipment items matching a name query string.
Creates a new equipment catalog entry.
Performs bulk creation of multiple equipment items in the global catalog.
Updates details of an existing equipment item entry.
Updates properties of an equipment item found by its unique index string (overrides base route).
Deletes an equipment catalog item by its database ID.
Retrieves all inventories in the system. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves all inventories assigned to a specific character.
Retrieves details of a specific inventory by ID. Bypasses normal authorization if it is a shop inventory.
Creates a new inventory record and broadcasts sync updates over SignalR.
Updates metadata/properties of an inventory and broadcasts sync changes.
Links an existing inventory to a character, and broadcasts character changes over SignalR.
Removes an inventory record and broadcasts sync deletion events.
Retrieves all equipment items in the specified inventory.
Retrieves details of a specific item inside an inventory.
Adds or increments the quantity of an equipment item inside an inventory, then broadcasts the sync update.
Appends a brand new equipment catalog record directly into the inventory and broadcasts the update.
Moves a specified quantity of an equipment item from a source inventory to a target inventory, broadcasting updates to both.
Transfers an equipment item from a source inventory into a target character's first available inventory, broadcasting sync changes.
Overwrites properties of a specific item inside an inventory, broadcasting changes.
Removes an item completely from the inventory and broadcasts the sync update.
Decrements the quantity of an item inside the inventory, deleting it if count reaches zero, and broadcasts updates.
Retrieves detailed stats of a monster by ID. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Retrieves a list of monsters matching the exact or partial name. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Retrieves all monsters registered in the system. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Retrieves a paginated list of monsters. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Advanced monster search supporting filters for name, type, CR ranges, tags, sorting, and paging. Accessible by Users, Admins, and DungeonMasters.
Creates a custom monster owned by the creating DM. Accessible by DungeonMasters and Admins.
Updates details of an existing custom monster. Accessible only by administrators.
Deletes a custom monster permanently. Accessible only by administrators.
Performs a soft-delete to hide a monster from listing queries. Accessible only by administrators.
Deletes a custom monster if the user is its owner. Accessible by DungeonMasters and Admins.
Transfers ownership of a custom monster to a different user. Accessible by DungeonMasters and Admins.
Grants co-ownership of a custom monster to another user. Accessible by DungeonMasters and Admins.
Retrieves the total count of monsters in the database. Accessible by Users, Admins, and DungeonMasters.
Retrieves details of a specific journal or session note by ID.
Retrieves multiple journal/session notes based on a comma-separated query parameter of IDs.
Creates a new journal or campaign note.
Updates details/content of an existing note.
Deletes a note permanently.
Sends a real-time SignalR notification to all users, or only to specific listed user IDs if specified.
Broadcasts a real-time SignalR notification to all clients EXCEPT the specified excluded user IDs.
Dispatches a hidden or GM-only subtle dice roll and returns the generated roll receipt.
Retrieves public dice roll history records, optionally filtering by campaignId (if the user has membership), otherwise retrieving the user's own public rolls.
Retrieves all categories of rule system documentation. Anonymous access allowed.
Creates a new category for system rules. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves a list of system rules matching filters (category, tag, source, search text) using cursor-based pagination. Anonymous access allowed.
Retrieves details of a specific system rule by its URL slug. Anonymous access allowed.
Retrieves rule-related statistics and metrics. Anonymous access allowed.
Registers a new system rule. Accessible only by administrators.
Updates details of an existing system rule by slug. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves details of a specific campaign session.
Retrieves all campaign sessions registered in the system.
Retrieves all session records associated with a specific campaign ID.
Creates a new campaign session record and broadcasts sync notifications.
Updates details of an existing campaign session and broadcasts sync notifications.
Deletes a campaign session by ID and broadcasts deletion sync updates.
Retrieves details of a specific shop.
Retrieves all shops associated with a campaign.
Creates a new merchant shop, sets up its inventory, and broadcasts the creation event.
Retrieves items and quantities currently available in the merchant shop inventory.
Handles merchant shop purchases: deducts gold from the character's wallet, adds items to their inventory, and adjusts shop stock.
Submits a request to sell items to the merchant shop, to be subsequently approved or rejected by the DM.
Retrieves list of submitted sell requests under a specified campaign.
Approves a pending sell request: increases selling character's currency and updates shop stock. Accessible only by Dungeon Masters.
Rejects a pending sell request. Accessible only by Dungeon Masters.
Updates metadata/properties of a merchant shop and broadcasts updates.
Toggles a shop's open or closed status and broadcasts the state change.
Deletes a merchant shop and its associated items, broadcasting updates.
Retrieves properties and details of a specific spell. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Retrieves a fast list of names and IDs for all spells in the catalog.
Retrieves all spells cataloged in the database. Accessible by Users and Admins.
Adds a new magic spell catalog entry. Accessible only by administrators.
Updates properties of an existing spell. Accessible only by administrators.
Deletes a spell entry permanently from the catalog. Accessible only by administrators.
Performs a logical soft-delete to hide a spell from query listings. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves the user profile details of the current authenticated user.
Retrieves a list of all registered user accounts. Accessible only by administrators.
Retrieves detailed profile data of a user by ID. Accessible only by administrators.
Updates profile details and roles of a user. Accessible only by administrators.
Updates user status flags (e.g., Active, Suspended). Accessible only by administrators.
Deletes a user account permanently. Accessible only by administrators.
Soft-deletes a user account to deactivate it. Accessible only by administrators.
